sources.name: SMM weekly carbonate inventory
sources.scope: four segments since 4 Sep 2026; backdated to 30 Apr
sources.method: estimates from public information, market communication and SMM's internal model
sources.issues: Scope changed 4 Sep: headline jumped from 78,800 t to about 175,000 t, prices fell over 14% in three days, and an SMM official said the impact may have been underestimated. SMM also says customs timing and sample verification can cause deviations

sources.name: Mysteel weekly carbonate inventory
sources.scope: 207 samples: converters 74, traders 61-62, cathode makers and end-users 72
sources.issues: About 80% of samples responded as of 16 Nov, so absolute levels carry deviation. Levels are lower than SMM's, and the two surveys can disagree on segment direction

sources.name: Benchmark monthly chemicals inventory
sources.issues: Reports -2.8% m/m in August and -10.0% year to date, with no usual H1 build and H2 drawdown

sources.name: GFEX registered receipts
sources.issues: Registered stock moves when holders cancel or re-register receipts, so a rise can be hidden stock becoming visible, not new supply. Units appear as tonnes in some reports and lots in others. Two newsletter editions disagreed on 16 Oct

sources.name: Fastmarkets benchmarks via CME / Voltaire newsletter
sources.scope: spodumene 6% CIF Asia, carbonate CIF Asia
sources.method: price assessment, reproduced by a third party
sources.issues: Secondary source; weekly points only, and the newsletter files for 30 Oct to 20 Nov could not be retrieved

notes: Mysteel (12 Aug) on the destocking-with-falling-prices paradox: the market shifted its pricing focus from the monthly inventory drawdown to expectations of weaker demand and more supply in 2027, and would keep pricing that until drawdowns turn into spot tightness.

Mysteel (12 Nov): warrants fell to a yearly low after concentrated cancellations at end-October, then rose each day in November as a weak basis and wide near-far spreads reopened delivery; some stock is moving from hidden inventory into visible warrants.
